# kafka_broker_config (Data Source)

Effective configuration of one broker and where each value comes from: `dynamic_broker` (set for this broker), `dynamic_default` (cluster-wide dynamic default), `static` (`server.properties`) or `default` (Kafka default).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kafka_broker_config" "broker_1" {
  broker_id = 1
}

# Settings changed at runtime (not in server.properties)
output "dynamic_settings" {
  value = {
    for c in data.kafka_broker_config.broker_1.configs :
    c.name => c.value if startswith(c.source, "dynamic_")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `broker_id` (Number) Node ID of the broker.

### Optional

- `include_defaults` (Boolean) Also list settings at their Kafka default. Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `configs` (Attributes List) Settings sorted by name. Sensitive values are empty (Kafka never returns them). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configs))
- `id` (String) The broker ID.

<a id="nestedatt--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configs`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Setting name.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Only changeable in `server.properties` (restart).
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Value is secret and not returned.
- `source` (String) `dynamic_broker`, `dynamic_default`, `static` or `default`.
- `value` (String) Effective value.
